name: The Coffee House
sourceName: WSFA 12 News — First Black-owned coffee shop opens in Montgomery
ownershipEvidence: WSFA identifies The Coffee House as Montgomery's first Black-owned coffee shop and quotes owner Mrs. Hardmon. The same report gives the 981 Adams Avenue location. The Montgomery Area Chamber of Commerce directory independently lists the business at 981 Adams Avenue and phone 334-564-4554.
notes: Official Instagram destination was located for the business; WSFA provides explicit ownership evidence and the numbered address, while the Montgomery Area Chamber directory independently corroborates the address and phone. Research-only; no current hours or availability inferred.
